summary.text: Dean Roy, a Freedom and Unity Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Vermont to Phil Scott.

He created the party, and the Associated Press (via Fortune) described him in March 2026 as a freshman at Stowe High School and the first candidate for governor under age 18 on Vermont's general-election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Dean Roy, who has said his political ambitions started in the eighth grade, worked as a legislative page at the Vermont Statehouse.
He said he did not identify with either major party and named housing as the most important issue facing the state.
Roy secured his place on the general-election ballot by creating the Freedom and Unity Party.
Vermont's constitution sets no minimum age for gubernatorial candidates and requires only that they have lived in the state for four years.
He said, "I don't expect necessarily to win," but that he hoped to start a movement that brings more young people into politics.
He received 0.4% of the vote to Phil Scott's 52.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Meet the 14-year-old running for governor of Vermont
